mathematics.assertion_tested: Measure 2x2 subpixel ray coverage on released source segmentation for compact and wide source windows, and source-plane position diameters for all existing branches; render preserved high/low/fixed-SED source and image arrays.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: float64, Gaussian linear nuisance integration, bounded nonlinear local optimization
mathematics.conventions: Corrected continuous zero-padded bilinear source basis only; same mass prior and shear sigma.10 component priors as fit_images_v2.py. Matched fixed-SIE source-marginal differences are diagnostics, not model Bayes factors.
inputs: Released VIS image/PSF/RMS/masks, fixed lens light geometry/template, canonical AQUAL field library01, imagefit02 starting parameters
non_claims: Geometric coverage does not eliminate source-prior assumptions.
Released source segmentation and image positions are pipeline diagnostics, not independent data.
No exact source-point identity is established by this statistic.
